_readme: Accepted-measurement policies for AnonRouter's own confidential gateway (the
first of the two hops this SDK verifies). The second hop, the upstream model
provider's enclave, is pinned separately in measurements.json.
THIS FILE MUST NEVER BE FETCHED FROM THE GATEWAY IT DESCRIBES. A verifier that
downloads its allowlist from the server it is verifying can always be handed an
allowlist naming that server. It ships inside the published packages instead, and
the CI parity gate proves the JavaScript and Python copies never drift.
status=published  a released plane, resolved by verifyGateway() by default.
status=candidate  a reviewed but pre-release plane whose pins are expected to
move. Requires allowCandidate: true, so a default call can
never quietly pass against a plane that is not released.
Every switch in a policy is REQUIRED. A truncated or hand-edited policy fails to
parse rather than silently disabling a check.

policies.notes: Reviewed retained accepted W8 pool release manifest SHA-256 5abba136544c2f961072b70e3e0c8ac7c20fad126044ba4dc16c3e9b604b4829; content-plane v1.0.26, image sha256:536e7fcb8be62ce027a764098f07237c1fdb282be9a71dc62334d75bcf08ce8d, reviewed source c5adf8ba59d2628b5ef1fb1e68c9c38e1993ad05. Exact measured compose and deployment app identity agree with the retained acceptance packet. Both production origins require fresh hardware verification, quote-bound observed TLS, private logs, digest-pinned images and UpToDate TCB. MRTD/RTMR0-2 and OS-image pins are unchanged from the prior reviewed Large deployment; MRCONFIGID binds the new measured compose. RTMR0 was not reproduced offline. Retained third-party provenance gaps and unavailable private application-log sweep remain documented supply-chain/observability limitations, not waived cryptographic checks. This policy is independently packaged; never fetched from the gateway being verified.
